purpose: Public cross-project state for Kaggle dataset portfolio planning, resumption, completion tracking, and adoption diagnosis.

source_of_truth_policy.portfolio: This repository is the public cross-project index only.
source_of_truth_policy.project: Each linked project repository is authoritative for its own pipeline, QA, provenance, release invariants, and history.
source_of_truth_policy.kaggle: Live Kaggle readback is authoritative for current version, processing status, live files, metadata, usability, and adoption metrics.

documentation_policy.rule: Keep all four README variants semantically synchronized for every public project unless explicitly opted out by the user. Commands, URLs, measured values, release status, source/rights claims, and interpretation caveats must remain aligned across translations.

completion_policy.rule: Before declaring a project fully complete at a terminal milestone, update this portfolio repository with the latest public project state and live Kaggle facts when relevant.

refresh_policy.before_portfolio_decisions: Refresh live Kaggle metrics/status when the decision depends on current adoption or publication state.
update_portfolio_when: a project reaches a terminal/completion milestone
a project is materially published or repositioned
a GitHub or Kaggle URL changes from pending to public
a release shape or major scale changes
meaningful external adoption changes the bottleneck
the primary next action materially changes

encoding_policy.rule: Never silently ignore or replace undecodable Korean/Japanese/Chinese/non-ASCII text; encoding failures are data-quality failures.

exclude: email addresses or other personal contact details
raw personal data not already intentionally public in a separately reviewed dataset release

metrics_note: Adoption metrics are point-in-time snapshots and must be refreshed from live Kaggle before decisions that depend on them.
current_priorities: Measure NHTSA launch adoption at the ~1-week checkpoint; keep the Data Explorer metadata blocker documented and avoid unnecessary content-version churn.
Diagnose discovery, activation, and vote conversion across the six published datasets before starting another large flagship collection.
Keep public project READMEs synchronized in English, Korean, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
Keep README.md, README.ko.md, README.ja.md, README.zh-CN.md, and portfolio.json synchronized after every project completion/terminal milestone and material state change.

projects.audience: economics, procurement, public-sector analytics, business ML
projects.source_authority: KONEPS / Korea public-data sources documented in the project repository
projects.rights_posture: Re-check source-specific public-data terms before each redistribution decision; the project repository is authoritative for the release gate.
public_caveats: Procurement stages and source feeds have distinct semantics; do not collapse them without preserving keys and provenance.
projects.next_action: Diagnose discovery and activation after the current Usability 10.0 release rather than creating an unnecessary content version.

projects.source_authority: Korea Power Exchange (KPX) public monthly files
projects.rights_posture: Use the source/licensing evidence recorded in the project repository and re-check when the release scope changes.
public_caveats: Demand, dispatch BASEPOINT, and state-estimated output are related but not interchangeable measurements.
The source files do not provide verified timezone metadata, so the project does not assert a timezone for timestamps.
projects.next_action: Diagnose discoverability and adoption conversion with the refreshed operations notebook before expanding the public release further.

projects.audience: computer vision, CLIP, VLM, multimodal learning
projects.rights_posture: Automatic release requires both record-level and exact selected media-item CC0 evidence as defined by the project rights gate.
public_caveats: Keep each object_id in one split to prevent object-level leakage.
Do not treat generated or composed model text as authoritative visual description beyond the documented source fields.
projects.next_action: Prioritize a compelling low-friction showcase and external reuse rather than adding more release files.

projects.geography: South Korea with global trading partners
projects.source_authority: Korea Customs Service public data and official annual HSK references
projects.rights_posture: Use the public-data/source terms and release evidence recorded in the project repository.
public_caveats: Do not pad or guess malformed/non-HSK10 source rows into valid 10-digit product codes.
Respect annual HSK revisions when interpreting product continuity through time.
projects.next_action: Keep the analysis notebooks discoverable and diagnose why downloads have not converted into votes or external notebooks.

projects.source_authority: Korean local-administration food-service permit data documented in the project repository
projects.rights_posture: Current public release scope follows the official public-data terms documented and re-verified by the project.
public_caveats: The current product is a permit snapshot, not a verified business survival/lifecycle panel.
Permit dates/statuses should not be silently reinterpreted as physical opening, revenue, or irreversible closure events.
projects.next_action: Preserve the simple snapshot positioning and use adoption evidence to decide whether a future lifecycle/history product is justified.

projects.audience: autonomous driving, vehicle safety, NLP, exploratory analysis
projects.source_authority: Official NHTSA Standing General Order public reports
projects.rights_posture: The project uses official public CSV releases and conservatively labels the Kaggle license Other rather than making a blanket public-domain claim over submitted narrative/content.
public_caveats: Raw manufacturer/reporting-entity counts are not normalized crash rates or safety rankings.
The V1 release uses the current third-amended reporting regime and does not force the historical archive into an incompatible schema.
Incident dates can predate the current reporting regime because later report versions can describe older incidents.
projects.next_action: At the ~1-week checkpoint, refresh views/downloads/votes and notebook reuse before changing positioning or publishing another content version.
